articles.summary: Sixty-five consecutive quarters of quarterly common stock dividend increases LITTLE ROCK, Ark., Oct. 01, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Bank OZK (the “Bank”) (Nasdaq: OZK) announced its Board of Directors declared a quarterly cash dividend on the Bank’s common stock of $0.49 per share, up $0.01, or 2.08%
articles.title: Bank OZK Announces Increase to Quarterly Common Stock Dividend and Announces Preferred Stock Dividend
